title: Matra — Thai Law Universal Schema v0.2 (มาตรฐานกลาง)
description: One standard for every Thai legal document type: codes, acts, secondary legislation, with TOC hierarchy, amendment timeline, cross-references, deka links, and annex/table support. v0.2 = v0.1 (grounded in real ocs-krisdika Criminal Code -63, 1031 sections + standard legal note schema) MERGED with Block-based/OLAW patterns (external standards profile, 2026-06/07): flattened polymorphic blocks, hierarchy_path embedding, VIGUEUR-style status gate, 3-tier validation flags, Hybrid-RAG routing metadata. Display may pivot per doc type; THIS standard never changes per law.

doc_id.description: Stable ID. Reuse Krisdika law_code+timeline (e.g. 'ป0006-1D-0003-63') so existing Krisdika-derived URLs keep working.

doc_type.description: ประมวล / พ.ร.บ.ให้ใช้ (SPLIT from code per spec) / พ.ร.บ. / พ.ร.ฎ. / พ.ร.ก. / กฎกระทรวง / ประกาศ / คำสั่ง / ระเบียบ / ข้อบังคับ / เอกสารตีความ / ฎีกา / บทความ / แบบฟอร์ม / คู่มือ

machine_translated.description: REQUIRED true whenever en text is machine-translated; provenance honesty

status.description: บังคับใช้อยู่ / รอมีผลใช้บังคับ / ยกเลิก — REQUIRED on every doc (core requirement of the standard)

status_evidence.description: How status was determined (source + date). Never asserted without evidence.

timeline.description: Fixes broken is_latest. Ordering derives from timeline_seq, newest first for display.

is_latest_computed.description: Computed = max(timeline_seq) in group. NOT the source field (broken upstream).

structure.description: Ordered tree nodes. TOC is GENERATED from this (source สารบาญ discarded as corrupted).

node_type.description: ภาค/ลักษณะ/หมวด/ส่วน/บท/มาตรา/ข้อ/วรรค + annex & table nodes (laws with แนบท้าย/ตาราง supported natively)

krisdika_type_id.description: Original sectionTypeId for lineage (6=ภาค 7=ลักษณะ 8=หมวด 9=ส่วน 4=มาตรา 10=ข้อ 14=countersign 15=remark 16=source-TOC)

number.description: '๙๐/๑' style kept verbatim; arabic mirror in number_arabic

parent_id.description: Tree link → TOC ภาค>ลักษณะ>หมวด>ส่วน>มาตรา generated by walk

hierarchy_path.description: Precomputed human path e.g. 'ประมวลกฎหมายอาญา > ภาค ๑ > ลักษณะ ๑ > หมวด ๑' — prepended before embedding (OLAW context-aware pattern) and rendered as breadcrumb

review_flag.description: 3-tier validation output (part of the standard): schema check hard-fails the run; this flag marks soft uncertainty for targeted human review

display.description: false for countersign (ผู้รับสนอง) and remark (หมายเหตุ) per standard display policy — kept in DB, hidden on web

status.description: Per-มาตรา status — a section can be repealed while its code stands (COLD etat pattern)

eId.description: AKN-style ASCII structural id (e.g. 'art_135_1', 'part_2__title_1_1'); recomputed per expression. Task 6′.

wId.description: = eId at first assignment (v0 contract). Frozen across renumbering once divergence is implemented (post-v0). Task 6′.

application_scope.description: Phased/retroactive/geographic application — single date pair is the common case, this is the escape hatch

paragraphs.description: วรรค of a มาตรา, in order. Formatting preserved to match searchlaw.ocs.go.th rendering (standard formatting reference).

table.description: For ตาราง/บัญชีแนบท้าย: {caption, columns[], rows[][], colspan map}. Universal container so table-laws need no schema change.

refs_out.description: กฎหมายอ้างกฎหมาย (มาตรา X แห่ง พ.ร.บ. Y)

deka_refs.description: ฎีกา ids attached at law level AND matra level (navigation requirement)

completeness.description: Additive v0.2 — มาตรา coverage of a consolidated code, so consumers (Stream A) can show honestly and nothing is dropped silently. present/min/max/contiguous/gaps describe the navigable CODE BODY (main doc) base มาตรา numbers (ทวิ/ตรี share a base). present_in_corpus counts base numbers anywhere in the law's records. gaps_absent = base numbers truly missing from the corpus (a real, declared coverage gap). gaps_unmerged = base numbers present in the corpus but not yet merged into the code body (merge-engine limit, NOT missing data). assembled/assembly_sources flag codes consolidated across records (e.g. the Civil & Commercial Code's 6 บรรพ).

flat_profile.description: Documents the flat export (1 row = 1 มาตรา, generated from tree). Not required — descriptor for the export produced by later pipeline tasks.

columns.description: Fixed column order for the flat export. const so drift fails validation.

reference_url.description: Per-record audit link (e.g. searchlaw.ocs.go.th doc URL) — every claim checkable

qa.description: ระบบตรวจทานอัตโนมัติ output — consumers see pass/fail per doc per standard, no manual full re-read

known_defects.description: What is wrong/missing, not only what works (Berkson lesson — log the invisible)

en_pair_doc.description: doc_id of English version when exists (keep TH and EN when an official translation exists)
